title: Washington Ecology confirms Hanford's Low-Activity Waste Facility is operating
summary: Washington Ecology says the Low-Activity Waste Facility began operation in October 2025 and is treating underground tank waste, independently corroborating the operating stage reported by DOE. Denominator: The named Low-Activity Waste Facility and its direct-feed low-activity-waste operating stage beginning in October 2025.
